blocks.text: I am starting this thread for data questions on the {{fact:f:E-2016-001.client}} valuation. My colleagues on copy will answer here as well.

The census file arrived last week and is loaded, and most records passed our first checks. Two gaps remain: some former employees have a termination date but no benefit status, and some active records have no date of hire. We have not filled either gap by assumption.
The data and plan terms need to be settled before we calculate anything. These items would close that stage:

items: Trust statements for the plan year, showing assets, contributions received, and benefits paid. The funding results are measured against these.
Any plan amendments adopted since the last valuation, or confirmation that there were none. We value the plan on its current terms, so we need them in hand.
Hire dates for the active records that lack them. Service is counted from those dates, and benefits follow from service.

blocks.text: Once these are in, we will send a short note on what the data show. Questions on assumptions will follow separately.
